items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: We had on our bill a great blues singer, Joe Williams who I thought was fabulous.

ctx.x: ...Deering's Farm and we had a very successful run there. We went in in August and stayed there till October or September. Everything was going great. We had on our bill a great blues singer, Joe Williams who I thought was fabulous. I had never heard anyone sing like him before - and a stage show there. Everything was going fine until Duke Ellington's band came to town and they happened to hear about us being there. Ben Webster and all the cats including Duke Ellington came out to the farm...
